rules.text: Never pipe the gate or tests through grep/tail/head — pipelines report the filter's exit code, not the test's. Run `scripts/gate.sh` bare; read the log at /tmp/duckterm-gate.log. Piped gates shipped two broken releases (RETRO.md).
rules.heading: Shipping

rules.text: A fix isn't done until shipped end-to-end: commit → gate → bump version → tag → fresh-worktree build (`scripts/build_package.sh`) → GitHub release with ABSOLUTE asset paths → `pipx install --force` → relaunch DuckTerm.app → curl the dashboard for 200.
rules.heading: Shipping

rules.text: Build releases from a fresh worktree at the tag with its own venv. Never import duckterm inside build scripts — read the version with sed. An import once aborted the build mid-bundle and shipped a partial app.
rules.heading: Shipping

rules.text: Other agent sessions work in this repo concurrently. Never stage whole contested files and never `git add -A`. Don't format, lint-fix, or delete another session's untracked WIP — exclude it and move on.
rules.heading: Parallel sessions

rules.text: Before releasing, verify the COMMITTED tree imports and compiles in a fresh worktree. The working tree lies when another session has WIP.
rules.heading: Parallel sessions

rules.text: Commit messages: problem / fix / how-tested. No Co-Authored-By trailers.
rules.heading: Conventions

rules.text: The server stays zero-dependency Python stdlib. Don't add pip deps to solve a problem stdlib can solve.
rules.heading: Conventions

rules.text: The user-facing term is "meta-harness" — never "suite" or "overlay" in UI or docs.
rules.heading: Conventions

rules.text: Append a lesson to RETRO.md after every real fix, newest first.
rules.heading: Conventions

rules.text: Probe/test sessions must carry test:true and be deleted afterwards. Never leave unflagged test data in the DB.
rules.heading: Testing hygiene

rules.text: Read complete test output (or the exit code) before claiming green — tail-truncated output has been misread as a pass twice.
rules.heading: Testing hygiene

rules.text: Verify visual changes at real size with real data before shipping — the user reviews screenshots/previews before implementation for anything visual. Prefer removing a struggling UI element over patching it; note the re-home idea in TODO.md.
rules.heading: UI changes

rules.text: fable-5 sessions have a 1M-token context window — don't compact or trim summaries preemptively at 200k-window thresholds.
rules.heading: Runtime-specific

rules.text: Answer approval prompts in your own terminal promptly — codex approvals fire no hooks, so nothing else will surface them to the user.
rules.heading: Runtime-specific
